snippet.title: DOPPELPARTMENT - Horror Game
snippet.description:
You're the building manager of an apartment complex. Your tasks are simple: taking care of the building, collecting rent, making sure your tenants are okay, etc. However, one night a soldier knocks on your door and gives you some disturbing news: some of your tenants have been replaced by doppelgangers.
Your mission? To identify these doppelgangers and report them to the soldier. However, things won't be easy for this poor old man....
Get ready for a week full of madness, body horror and knocks on your door.

Author: A. V. Dossow
Game link: https://avdossow.itch.io/doppelpartment
